description.en: Tunchang County is a county in the Hainan Province of People's Republic of China. Covering approximately 1,240 km2 , it is centrally located within the Hainan province and bridges the province’s northern plains and central highlands.
description.zh-CN: 屯昌县是海南省的一个县。位于海南岛中部偏北。
description.zh-TW: 屯昌縣是海南省的一個縣。位於海南島中部偏北。
